label: PF Backlog 502
title: Canonical artifact->owner->consumer map (PRD/tech/app-flow/design/schema/impl-plan) - registry + generated doc + gate
body:
## Problem / why
The product docs (PRD, technical requirements, app flow, design brief, data model/schema, implementation plan)
are produced by pipeline agents, but there is NO canonical, in-sync map of artifact -> owner agent -> consumers
(what each doc is, who makes it, who reads it next). It was only inferrable from prose agent cards.

## Goal & value
A single, validated source of truth mapping every product artifact to its owner agent and its consumers
(so 'who takes it forward' is explicit), rendered to docs and kept fresh by a gate.

## In scope
- config/artifact-owners.json: registry {name, path, owner (agent), consumers[], purpose, phase}.
- scripts/dev/gen_artifact_map.py: validates owner/consumers against core.agent_structure.KNOWN_AGENTS, renders
  docs/ARTIFACT-OWNERS.md (artifact table + pipeline order); --check fails when the doc is stale.
- Wire gen_artifact_map --check into precheck; register the config + classify the doc.

## Out of scope
- Deriving artifact lists from the agent specs (their prose is incomplete; deferred).

brief.problem: the product docs agents produce (PRD/tech/app-flow/design/schema/impl-plan) have no canonical map of who owns each and who consumes it next
brief.what_adds: a validated registry mapping every product artifact to its owner agent and consumers, rendered to docs/ARTIFACT-OWNERS.md and kept fresh by a precheck gate
brief.why: so ownership and hand-off ('who takes it forward') are explicit and never drift
brief.who_feels: the pipeline/orchestrator + anyone reading a generated product's docs

objective: a canonical, validated artifact->owner->consumer map is generated and gate-checked
acceptance_criteria: config/artifact-owners.json is the single source of truth
docs/ARTIFACT-OWNERS.md is generated and --check fails when stale
approach: curated registry (validated) + generator renders the doc; --check diffs for staleness
risks: registry drifts from actual agents -> mitigated by validation + check gate

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/artifact_registry.py, core/change_registry.py, core/design_critic.py, core/design_tokens.py
